newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CZECH AIRLINE CSA CARGO TRADE DOWN 2.6 PCT JAN-MAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH AIRLINE CSA CARGO TRADE DOWN 2.6 PCT JAN-MAY.

text.p: Czech national airline Ceske Aerolinie AS (CSA) said its cargo trade through Airport Ruzyne
in Prague in the January-to-May period decreased 2.6 percent in
